frontier.observed: Canonical recovery can raise RecoveryIntegrityError when the causal/state spine cannot be trusted, while the MicroVM contract requires an external full Pod/Kata sandbox replacement for Tier-2. Before this delta the service exposed only a generic process failure and the deployment profile had no typed machine-readable bridge from canonical integrity failure to the external replacer.
frontier.hypothesis: A reserved fail-closed exit code plus a bounded Kubernetes termination message gives deployment infrastructure an unambiguous Tier-2 trigger without creating a second state/recovery authority.
frontier.counterhypothesis: A generic non-zero container exit is sufficient for Tier-2 orchestration.
frontier.cheapest_discriminator: Execute the exact signal builder and exact service recovery-integrity path, then require a future Kubernetes/Kata run to observe exit 86 and replace the complete Pod/Kata sandbox.

primary_upstream_basis: Kubernetes official documentation states that terminationMessagePath defaults to /dev/termination-log, File populates the terminated container status message from that file, and terminated container state exposes the exit code. The ClayVerse-specific meaning of exit 86 is repository policy, not a Kubernetes-reserved semantic.

execution.service_integration_test: 1/1 PASS in 0.13s with non-exercised imports stubbed

evidence_boundary: The exact-file executions support the Tier-2 signal construction and service dispatch mechanism only. They do not prove Kubernetes termination-message collection, controller observation of exit 86, full Pod deletion, fresh Kata sandbox/VM identity, same OCI digest, persistent-state recovery, generation fencing or no-replay behavior on a real admitted target.
promotion_gate: In an authorized isolated Kubernetes/Kata-capable run, force a real RecoveryIntegrityError, observe terminated exitCode 86 and clayverse.tier2-fatal/v1 when available, prove the external controller deletes/replaces the whole Pod/Kata sandbox rather than restarting in place, prove new Pod UID and new Kata sandbox/VM identity with the same accepted OCI digest, recover declared persistent state under a new global generation, and verify ambiguous external effects are not replayed. Also fuse the compatible startupProbe delta from #647 before promotion if still current.

unusual_experiment.reason: The exact user trigger exposes no shared immutable request/turn id and only minute-precision immutable message metadata, so the atomic unusual-experiment lease cannot be safely minted.
